mistake_reason: At step 6, the Assistant decided to exclude entries with blank Words/Day and proceed without clarifying or fixing the missing data for "Out of the Silent Planet" (which had a text-formatted Start Date causing a formula error). This is a failure to ask for clarification when faced with incomplete/ambiguous data. The assistant should have requested data cleaning or asked FileSurfer to normalize the date formats and recompute WPD for the affected entries. Instead, it accepted truncated results and made the decision based only on the subset of rows with computed WPD, leading to the wrong final answer. This matches FM-2.2: Fail to Ask for Clarification.
